asset_context.relationship: Monitoring/measurement locations; not ownership, contract, buyer commitment or verified treatment-benefit recipient

application.name: Source-water monitoring and investment evidence desk
buyer_roles: watershed fund or project sponsor managing monitoring spend
application.commercial_status: Buyer roles are intended users, not contracted customers
application.transaction_supported: A reviewable monitoring work order and evidence packet; no financial transaction executed
operational_sequence: Read an eligible forecast monitoring window and source-quality state
Apply the frozen chronological one-alert/day policy
Review expected monitoring spend from an explicit per-sample cost input
Collect and independently verify field/lab evidence outside this prototype
Attach verified evidence to a separately authorized financing review

gates.label: Station and dataset identity
gates.evidence: USGS official catalogues, source receipt hashes and published operator crosswalk
gates.decision: Use the named measurement support; do not claim parcel delivery or ownership

gates.label: Untouched prediction and alert performance
gates.decision: Populate only after model freeze and independent final review

gates.label: Live data availability and service reliability
gates.evidence: Historical approved archives and declared30-minute assumption
gates.decision: A live service-level promise needs release-time telemetry and monitored operation

gates.label: Sampling access and laboratory verification
gates.evidence: No operator sampling permission, chain of custody or paired newSSC sample supplied
gates.decision: Forecast flags cannot substitute for actual sample collection/results

gates.label: Additional environmental effect
gates.evidence: No causal intervention estimate, verified source-to-receptor effect or local treatment response
gates.decision: No credit issuance, avoided-loss estimate or performance-based payment derived

gates.label: Land, water and action rights
gates.evidence: Public monitoring stations and basin polygons do not establish rights
gates.decision: No automatic action or financing approval

gates.label: Buyer, operating threshold and cash costs
gates.evidence: No contracted buyer, actual laboratory quote, treatment operating curve or loss data
gates.decision: Input-based monitoring spend only; ROI and savings remain null

gates.label: Financing allocation and independent review
gates.evidence: No issuance framework, use-of-proceeds ledger, funds transfer or independent financial assurance
gates.decision: Export evidence for review, not approve a loan, bond, credit or payout

financial_calculations.monitoring_spend_usd: explicit user cost_per_sample_usd multiplied by accepted alert-window count; hypothetical if cost is hypothetical
financial_calculations.sample_count_warning: Accepted alerts are proposed monitoring windows, not completed samples or invoices

reference_frameworks.document: Water utilities and services additional sector guidance,June2025
reference_frameworks.use: Supports contextual water targets and sector disclosure; this desk is not TNFD certification or a complete LEAP assessment
Project evaluation,proceeds tracking and impact reporting require evidence; this desk provides a monitoring evidence input, not a bond eligibility opinion

source_reuse: NorthernWater public automated retrieval permission does not imply unrestricted raw redistribution. Public release includes derived QA and source links, not its native bulk observations. USGS forecast evidence retains attribution.
interpretation: The proposed business linkage is an implementation inference from validated monitoring performance and documented financing processes. It is not demonstrated sales demand, treatment benefit or financial return.
